{{Top|leg|title=j'ber D'Trel}}
'''J'ber D'Trel''' was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]]. It was dominant in the [[o'beki]] of [[Graith]] and eventually emerged as the dominant j'ber on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], becoming the effective planetary government. Its members included [[D'Trel B'Far Jok]] and [[D'Trel B'Far Talis]].
